image_description: A top-down view of a black cast-iron skillet resting on a white stovetop. The pan contains several pieces of raw meat (likely pork chops or steaks) that are heavily coated in flour and seasoning. The handle of the skillet extends towards the bottom left, featuring a helper handle loop at the top left. The background shows parts of the stove grates.

The connection point of the helper handle (top left) to the pan rim appears slightly soft or fused, lacking a sharp mechanical boundary, but is likely within acceptable generation variance.
